import sys

import random

r = random.Random(20260926)
n = 100000
a = []
peak = 1000000
while len(a) < n:
    a.append(peak)
    nxt = peak - r.randint(-3, 12)
    for _ in range(r.randint(1, 6)):
        a.append(r.randint(1, nxt - 1))
    peak = nxt
a = a[:n]
print(n)
print(' '.join(map(str, a)))
